messages:
mina: Heads-up: dry-run for promo to eu-west failed. helm template can't merge overlays/edgezone due to boolean/string mismatch for featureFlags.enableBilling. Need quick decision before window closes.

henry: paste CI error?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: DRY-RUN FAILED
service billing: helm template error
Command: helm upgrade --install billing ./charts/billing --dry-run --values values/eu.yaml --values overlays/edgezone.yaml
Error: conflicting types for key 'featureFlags.enableBilling' (bool vs string)
Logs: http://ci.internal/DRY-9002

mina: Overlay has "true" (string) while chart expects true (boolean). Auto-merge would coerce and possibly change behavior.

henry: Short-term: pin billing chart to 2.4.0 and promote. We'll follow up with a small hotpatch to normalize overlay values and add a pre-merge check. Pin is safest for the change window.

mina: Agree. Who can push the pin and run canary?

henry: I can. I'll open a tiny PR changing chartVersion in overlays/edgezone/kustomization.yaml and add a note about follow-up. Commands I run:
```
git checkout -b fix/edgezone-billing-pin-1781
yq e '.resources[0].chartVersion = "2.4.0"' -i overlays/edgezone/kustomization.yaml
git add overlays/edgezone/kustomization.yaml && git commit -m "pin billing chart to 2.4.0 to avoid featureFlags type drift" && git push origin fix/edgezone-billing-pin-1781
```
This will trigger deploy-bot after merge.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: PR merged. Starting canary billing@2.4.0 at 5% traffic. Canary id CAN-BILL-1781.

ops-bot: k8s: canary started. billing-eu-canary pods x3. Ready 3/3. Recommend 20m observation and set resources to ensure stability.

qa-bot: automated smoke: login flow OK, billing charge simulation OK, featureFlags.enableBilling true path exercised. No failures in smoke tests.

mina: Draft release note: "Temporarily pinned billing chart to 2.4.0 due to overlay values type drift in edgezone; follow-up hotpatch to normalize featureFlags.enableBilling to boolean and add CI validation."

henry: Add rollback snippet to the note:
```
# rollback
prev=$(helm history billing -n prod | sed -n '2p' | awk '{print $1}')
helm rollback billing $prev -n prod
kubectl -n prod rollout status deployment/billing
```
And tag #oncall if rollback needed.

ops-bot: canary metrics @15m: p50 latency +1%, errors 0.0%, readiness 100%. No alerts.

mina: Bump to 30% now if stable. henry: please proceed.

henry: Bumping. deploy-bot: route-canary CAN-BILL-1781 set-traffic 30%

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: traffic updated to 30% for CAN-BILL-1781.

ops-bot: 30% at 12m: steady. CPU at 55% of request, p95 unchanged.

mina: Suggest hold for another 10m then promote to 100% unless anyone objects.

henry: No objections.

ops-bot: final check at 40m overall: no regressions.

henry: Promoting now. deploy-bot: promote CAN-BILL-1781

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: promoted canary CAN-BILL-1781 to stable release billing@2.4.0. Notifying release-notes-bot.

release-notes-bot: release-notes-bot: Added entry 2024-12-15: 'Pinned billing chart to 2.4.0 due to overlay values type mismatch in edgezone; hotpatch scheduled to normalize featureFlags.enableBilling and add CI type checks.'

ops-bot: prod rollout complete. pods ready 6/6. No incidents.

mina: Filing follow-up ticket to convert overlay value to boolean, add yq type check in CI, and write a tiny migration note for ops. Assigning to infra-team.

henry: Thanks all. Closing after release notes link posted.

release-notes-bot: release-notes-bot: https://releases.internal/notes/2024-12-15/billing-overlay-type-pin
